message: Update version to 0.11.4.
Update TJA parser to calculate gaps that exceed 1 measure. Remove gap value when the previous note is not don/ka.
Add a script to apply analysis to all ESE charts that have a corresponding song mapping. Currently this contains only the note gaps.
Fix parameter propagation for prepare-data.
Update the data fetching script to use the taiko.wiki API instead of GitHub raw content address.
Update prepare-data script to invoke build-data in the end.
Update song_mapping.json.
Update prepare-data script to handle previously resolved ESE paths that no longer exist.
Update prepare-data script to replacet the deprecated version of TaikoRatingAnalyzer file with links to its CDN. Update parsing logic to adapt to the new format.
Update the importing process to allow storing unmatched entires.
Move the HTML importer function from settings-panel to a new file.
(Maybe failed) attempt to fix the gap between long note segments across bars.
Add debug logging for app startup performance.
Fix the issue where vertical inset is applied between the bars and the attribution text.
Add a script to package ESE data and upload to GitHub release, for potential offline support in the future.
Update version to 0.11.3.
Fix missing spacing between rendered chart header and the first bar.
Impove import process to skip the manual paste of HTML when importing to the web version of the app.
Update version to 0.11.2.
Fix status message style in action button when there is a split dropdown button.
Add an advanced search option to filter by a BPM range.
Fix some test failures.
Extend the modal page for a variant that anchors at a given element. Update annotation tab to display auto annotation settings in a modal page.

Update action button to support both a primary action and a dropdown menu. Use this for the "share current chart" button to allow sharing with search options. Fix top/bottom inset of the rendered chart.
Update version to 0.11.1.
Apply page background color to status bar area for PWA. Let full screeen rendered chart fill the entire screen.
Consolidate button implementations across the app. Slightly adjust some styles.
Keep font size consistent on iOS potriat and landscape modes.
Update version to 0.11.0.
Update the layout of the two steppers in annotation tab to make them two separate rows.
Update annotation tool selection UI to a custom segmented control element. Fix annotation click handling from previous commit.
Refactor chart annotation definitions and usage, replacing string with custom types. Add a missing snapshot change.
Support a note separator annotation type. Allow switching between separator and hand annotation types, and adding/removing the separtor by clicking on the notes.
Reduce panels horiztonal padding. Adjust panel and page background colors. Adjust spacing between panels and remove unnecessary top/bottom padding in vertical layout.
Add an option to auto annotate all notes.
Update the layout of the annotate tab content to be more consistent with other tabs.
Allow customizing hand inference during auto annotation to accomodate different hand alternation styles.
Slightly update the style of the zoom stepper controls, and make a reusable component from it.
Update version to 0.10.6.
Attempt to preserve app state for the PWA version.
Update URL scheme to support search parameters. Use this to preserve search state by dynamically updating the current URL.
Add a subheading and divider for the selection export section.
Improve styling consistency of text input elements. Make sure it has enough font size to avoid zooming on tap on iOS.
Support selection of charts with different player sides by extending the parser and app UI.
Slight adjustment to wiki hyperlink style on hover.
Update version to 0.10.5.
Update song_mapping.
Include Wiki URLs when processing external data. Add Wiki links to the app as a dropdown button.
Replace text with icon for the export image button.
Support "display only selected" for branching charts when a single branch is selected.
Update tests and snapshots for recent change.
Further simplify the chart options status panel.
Remove note type stat panel, extend the gap stat panel to include gap in seconds. Improve consistency of labels across the app.
Basic support for rating.taiko.wiki playdata import.
Update long notes rendering so that it has the same hover style as the other notes.
Update version to 0.10.4.
Slightly adjust radio and checkbox inputs style. Make the style consistent across the app.
Clear annotations when chart difficulty changes.
Disable note selection highlighting in exported image when "display only selected" is on.
Update app font size spcification for more consistent result across platforms. Update chart options mode status label and hide it when the panel is expanded.
More adjustment to advanced search layout.
Add to renderer a way to attribute TJA file source. Use this for ESE charts in the app.
Remove unnecessary spacing below data source panel.
Update version to 0.10.3.
Improve advanced search layout under low width.
Fix broken tests.
Add some padding for the tja-chart message state. Run formatter.
Refactor modal page implementations with a reusable component. Update its vertical layout behavior to behave like a buttom sheet.
Fix blurry long note extension.
Improve button styling consistency.
Improve long note extension drawing so that the fade is more consistent with the remaining of the chart.
Update version to 0.10.2.
Update the colors of drumroll and ballon notes, and the colors for difficulties.
Attempt (again) to fix dev hot reloading when there is a renderer package change. Update gitignore.
Draw a leading circle for drumroll long notes.
Fix ESE chart loading for items with "+" in the path.
Draw long note extension for line beginning/end.
For auto zoom calculation. Evaluate full note diameter instead of the inner circle.
Slight adjustment in ballon number text sizing and positioning.
Remove the white border from ballon/kasudama trailing capsule.
Update renderer to support title and subtitle override. Make use of these instead of modifying the chart from the app.
Update data preparation and index generation processes for a clearer separation between data that should be tracked and data that is derived in a deterministic way. Fix some test cases.
Add a setting for preferred chart title/subtitle language independent from app language.
Update version to 0.10.1.
Change chart list ura label to just Ura instead of Oni(Ura) and fix difficulty-specific selection highlight bugs.
Make chart list items difficulty-aware when using advanced search filters.
Update version to 0.10.0.
Update 1 outdated snapshot.
Fetch 10 star DFC difficulty data and add a filtering option for it.
Add to advanced search filtering by playdata category.
Set up advanced search which allows filtering by difficulty, stars, BPM and more.
Update song_mapping.
Expand ESE index to include additional metadata.
Update version to 0.9.8.
Allow more flexibility in playdata display. Move the dropdown to settings page.
Update song mapping format. Incorporate DonderHelper data for more localized titles.
Simplify some UI label text.
Update version to 0.9.7.
Slightly reduce inner border width multiplier for selected notes.
Remove the inner (white) border from drumroll notes.
